usdRate.sourceName: Trading Economics, USD/AZN (central bank official rate)
usdRate.note: The manat has been held at 1.70 per US dollar since 2017; World Bank 2025 average 1.70.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: State Statistical Committee of Azerbaijan, Changes in consumer prices (September 2026)
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices up 5.5% on September 2025 (food 6.9%, non-food 3.6%, services 5.1%); January-September average 5.7%.

inflation_projection.note: The 5-year average is about 7.4% but inflation has been inside the central bank's 2-6% band since 2024, so 5.5% (upper half of the band) is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics (Central Bank of Azerbaijan discount rate decision)
policy_rate.note: Discount (refinancing) rate held at 6.5% on 23 September 2026; corridor 5-7.5%. Secondary source because cbar.az refused connections; IMF IFS also shows 6.5% for August 2026.

savings_account_rate.note: cbar.az (deposit rate statistics) refused connections and no bank-level demand deposit rate was found; IMF only publishes the overall average deposit rate.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No 3-month term deposit rate found: the central bank's statistical bulletin (cbar.az) was unreachable.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No 1-year term deposit rate found: the central bank's statistical bulletin (cbar.az) was unreachable; the average rate on manat deposits was 8.58% in August 2026 (IMF IFS).

dps_rate.note: No data on monthly recurring deposit products found; cbar.az unreachable.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: IMF International Financial Statistics (MFS_IR), Azerbaijan deposit rate, national currency
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on manat deposits, August 2026 (9.33% in January 2026); foreign-currency deposits 2.86%. World Bank 2025 annual value 9.36%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found; Ministry of Finance bonds are sold through the Baku Stock Exchange mainly to institutions.

tbill_91d_rate.note: IMF's treasury bill series for Azerbaijan ends in 2017 and the Baku Stock Exchange / central bank pages were not reachable.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year government bond yield found; Trading Economics has no Azerbaijan bond yield and bfb.az/cbar.az were not reachable.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield found; Azerbaijan issues few long manat bonds and no market yield is published on the sources read.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Azerbaijan income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: 10% final withholding tax on Azeri-source interest; PwC also notes a seven-year exemption for individuals' bank deposit interest from 1 February 2016, so check whether a current exemption applies to manat deposits.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists; PwC does not describe the tax treatment of government bond interest.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: The Azerbaijan Deposit Insurance Fund (adif.az) and cbar.az refused connections and no other source read stated the current cover per depositor.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate found; the average lending rate in manats was 15.9% in August 2026 (IMF IFS).

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in US dollar terms; manat pegged at 1.70 per USD
equity_return_low.note: Azerbaijan has no liquid local stock market, so equity is a global index fund in manat terms; low case is a weak decade for world shares.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity long-run return in USD; after-tax average manat deposit 8.58% x 0.9 = 7.7%
equity_return_base.note: Base on a global index in manat terms (about 7% in dollars plus about 1% expected manat depreciation), kept close to the after-tax deposit rate because manat deposits already pay well.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run return in USD plus manat depreciation risk
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong world shares plus some manat weakening, as in 2015-2016.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD 3,876/oz on 30 Oct 2026, 31% below the January 2026 high; manat pegged
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold flat in dollars after its 2025-26 spike with a stable manat.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); manat pegged at 1.70 since 2017
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises with world inflation plus a little, plus about 1% a year expected manat depreciation.

gold_return_high.note: High case: gold's strong 2005-2025 trend continues or the manat is devalued again.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Average manat deposit rate 8.58% (Aug 2026), falling about 0.75 points in 2026
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates keep falling with the policy rate and 10% tax applies.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Average manat deposit rate 8.58% less 10% withholding = 7.7%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: the after-tax average deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Average manat deposit rate 8.58% (IMF IFS), tax-exempt case
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer manat deposits at or above the average, with interest exempt from tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The central bank (insurance supervisor since 2020) site was unreachable; no industry life claim settlement ratio found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Life insurance is a small market in Azerbaijan; no published term-life premium quotes were found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical cost of a major private hospital stay found; mandatory health insurance covers a basic package in public facilities.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: AzStat price index of paid services: +6.5% in 2025, +8.2% in 2023
goal_inflation_health.note: No separate medical CPI was found; paid services have risen faster than headline CPI, so 7% is used for health costs.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: AzStat price index of paid services: +6.5% in 2025; September 2026 release notes higher-education and course fee rises
goal_inflation_education.note: No separate education CPI was found; tuition fees rose again in September 2026, so 7% is used.

life_expectancy.sourceName: State Statistical Committee of Azerbaijan, life expectancy at birth
life_expectancy.note: Men 74.9, women 79.3 in 2025 (national figure); UN WPP estimates 74.9 for 2026 and the World Bank 74.6 for 2024.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate); national tables give longer lives.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 13.2 (2025, World Bank), 22.1 (2040) and 37.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/azerbaijan/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of Population, Old-age Labor Pension
retirement_age_default.note: Retirement age 65 for men (since July 2021) and for women from 1 July 2026; 25 insurance years needed unless pension capital covers the minimum pension.

retirement_age_government.note: No source read states a separate retirement or age limit for civil servants.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Average manat deposit rate 8.58% (IMF IFS), falling
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: deposit rates fall further and 10% tax applies.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Average manat deposit rate 8.58% less 10% withholding = 7.7%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept just under the after-tax average deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer manat deposits with interest exempt from tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax deposit 7.7%; global equity low case 5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix of manat deposits and a global equity fund.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half manat deposits and half global shares in manat terms.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of Population, Old-age Labor Pension (social benefit for age)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social benefit for age 220 manats a month as of 1 January 2023 (the latest amount stated); minimum labour pension 320 manats since 1 February 2025.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of Population, Old-age Labor Pension
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid to people at retirement age who have no right to a labour pension and are not working; not income-tested as such.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code provides severance pay on dismissal by the employer but no statutory gratuity on retirement or resignation was found.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of Population, Labour pensions
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory labour pension: pension = insurance capital / expected payment months, minimum 320 manats; pensions are indexed each year under the Law On Labour Pensions (average assigned pension up 10.5% to 594.4 manats by July 2026, AzStat). Tax treatment not confirmed.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit scheme was found; some term deposits allow top-ups.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned on the Baku Stock Exchange, mainly to banks.

tbond_5y.note: Issued in manat and US dollars, mostly bought by institutions.

tbond_10y.note: No regular 10-year manat government bond found.

equity_fund.note: The local stock market is very small and no widely available diversified retail fund was found; residents can buy foreign index funds through brokers.

gold.note: Physical gold bars and coins can be bought legally.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan

insuranceRegulator.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan (insurance supervision)
insuranceRegulator.note: The central bank supervises insurers since 2020.

insuranceComplaints.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Azerbaijan, consumer complaints

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social benefit for age (Ministry of Labour and Social Protection of Population)

publicHealthCover.name: State Agency on Mandatory Health Insurance

statistics.name: State Statistical Committee of the Republic of Azerbaijan
